en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large group of workers, including men, women and children, posing in front of an industrial courtyard with long plastered buildings, a picket fence and an external stair. Caption at the bottom reads "Avrig – Fabrica de Sticlărie." The reverse is a divided back with "România – Cartă Postală," address lines, and the publisher credit "Editura Gh. Maxim, Avrig," plus an archival stamp and pencil notes.
